newsitem.title: HONG KONG: South China Strategic issues new shares.
newsitem.headline: South China Strategic issues new shares.

text.p: South China Strategic Ltd said on Tuesday it had conditionally agreed to issue 189 million new shares to Onswin Ltd, a unit of South China Industries Ltd, raising about HK$38 million for general working capital.

The diversified pharmaceutical and investment company said Onswin had placed 75.6 million South China Strategic shares, or about eight percent of the the company's issued share capital, at HK$0.21 a share to third parties. Onswin would subscribe to the new shares at a price equal to the net price received for the placement shares.
The 189 million new shares represent about 20 percent of the existing issued share capital of South China Strategic and 16.7 percent of the the enlarged share capital.
Onswin owns about 60.5 percent of the existing issue share capital of South China Strategic and will have about 60.4 percent after the transactions.
